title: What happens if my child starts showing regression during or after ABA therapy at Pinnacle Blooms?
metaTitle: Managing Regression in ABA Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms | Supporting Your Child's Progress
description: Learn how therapists at Pinnacle Blooms address regression in ABA therapy. Discover how we reassess and modify treatment plans to support your child's progress in overcoming challenges.
html: Regression can occasionally occur. If this happens, therapists at Pinnacle Blooms reassess the child鈥檚 situation, modify the treatment plan if needed, and work intensively to regain and advance from the previously learned skills.
